title: Standing Hamstring Stretch - Dynamic
access: Search-cached complete exercise notes; direct open redirected500. Video not downloaded or claimed visually inspected.
protocol: Stand shoulder-width apart with target foot slightly forward. Keep flat back, neutral spine and foot position. Hinge at hip and reach toward toes; slowly return and repeat. Avoid excessive back rounding.
variant: RIGHT foot forward, knee straight, neutral flat feet; LEFT support knee bent. Both arms reach down toward front foot during hip hinge. Two4second cycles, no static hold.
limitations: Demonstration55degree hinge is not prescribed source ROM. One prepared stance and one side, no step transition.
